channel.title: Uptick
channel.description: Uptick explains the stories everyone is searching for, from breaking news and sports to tech, health and culture, in clear, sourced explainers updated as they change.

item.title: Canelo vs. Mbilli: Alvarez Wins Back WBC Title on Decision
item.description: Canelo vs. Mbilli result: Canelo Alvarez beat Christian Mbilli by unanimous decision in Riyadh to regain the WBC super middleweight title. Scores and what’s next.

item.title: Poland Constitutional Tribunal Crisis: Court Chief Suspended
item.description: Poland’s Constitutional Tribunal crisis: a judge suspended the court’s chief and President Nawrocki rushed back from Senegal. What happened and what’s next.

item.title: Election Workers: Judge Bars DOJ and DHS Threats Before Midterms
item.description: A judge barred DOJ and DHS from threatening election workers over ballots the government calls ineligible. What the order does and how long it lasts.

item.title: Midterm Elections 2026: What’s at Stake on Tuesday, Nov. 3
item.description: The 2026 midterm elections are Tuesday, Nov. 3. The House and Senate math, the Senate races to watch, early voting so far and why results may take days.

item.title: Moscow Terror Threat: US Warns of Mass Casualty Risk at Tsaritsyno
item.description: The US Embassy in Moscow warned of a credible mass casualty threat at the Tsaritsyno museum on Oct. 31. What it said, how Russia responded, the 2024 parallel.

item.title: Patrick Stewart Dies at 86: What Lewy Body Dementia Is
item.description: Patrick Stewart, Star Trek’s Captain Picard and X-Men’s Professor X, died at 86 with Alzheimer’s and Lewy body dementia. His career and what the diseases are.

item.title: Spain Train Crash: 69 Dead Near Toledo, 2nd on Same Line in 2026
item.description: The Spain train crash near Urda, Toledo, killed at least 69 on the Madrid-Seville line. What officials say went wrong, the signal-system delay and what’s next.

item.title: Binance Hack: FBI Blames North Korea as Withdrawals Resume
item.description: The FBI says North Korea’s TraderTraitor unit carried out the $6.3 billion Binance hack. Withdrawals reopened Nov. 1. What happened and what users should know.

item.title: Alphabet Stock Has Its Worst Day Ever, Losing Nearly $500B
item.description: Alphabet stock fell nearly 13% on Oct. 29 after Q3 results showed slower search growth and $9.1 billion in negative free cash flow. What went wrong and what’s next.

item.title: Daylight Saving Time Ends Nov. 1: Clocks Fall Back One Hour
item.description: Daylight saving time 2026 ends at 2 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 1, when clocks fall back an hour. Who changes, why Congress hasn’t ended it, and when it returns.

item.title: Lagarde Resigns: ECB President to Leave Feb. 7, 2027, Early
item.description: Christine Lagarde will leave the ECB on Feb. 7, 2027, almost nine months early. Why it matters, who could replace her and how the successor is picked.

item.title: Fed Holds Rates at 3.75%-4% as Cook and Hammack Push for a Hike
item.description: The Federal Reserve held its rate at 3.75% to 4% on Oct. 28, with two officials voting for a hike. What changed, why it paused and what December may bring.

item.title: Bank of Canada Raises Rate to 2.5%, Its First Hike Since 2023
item.description: The Bank of Canada raised its key rate to 2.5% on Oct. 28 to keep high energy prices from spreading. What it means for mortgages and what comes next.

item.title: UK Be Ready Checklist: Why Beans and Water Are Selling Out
item.description: The UK’s Be Ready campaign asks households to keep three days of supplies. Here’s what’s on the checklist and why beans, water and radios sold out.

item.title: Israel Election Results: Netanyahu Bloc 53, Short of a Majority
item.description: Israel election results 2026: with all votes counted, Netanyahu’s bloc has 53 seats, Eisenkot’s 48 and Arab parties a record 19. What comes next.

item.title: Anthropic IPO: S-1 Shows $16.3B Half-Year Revenue, Ticker ANT
item.description: Anthropic IPO filing explained: the Claude maker’s public S-1 shows $16.3 billion in first-half revenue, an $80.7 billion net loss and a Nasdaq ticker, ANT.

item.title: Comey Charged a 3rd Time Over a 2016 Leak to The New York Times
item.description: James Comey charged again: the Justice Department accuses the ex-FBI director of leaking defense information in 2016. Here’s the case and the deadline fight.

item.title: Machado Returns to Venezuela After 10 Months, Pushes for a Vote
item.description: María Corina Machado returned to Venezuela on Oct. 25 after 10 months abroad. Here’s how she got back, why it matters and where the push for elections stands.

item.title: Serbia Election Results: Student List Wins as Vučić Concedes
item.description: Serbia election results: the student-led Student List won about 52.5% on Oct. 25 and Vučić conceded. See the seat math, how it happened and what comes next.

item.title: Hunter’s Moon 2026: Peak Time, Meaning and What to See Tonight
item.description: October’s Hunter’s Moon was full at 12:11 a.m. ET on Oct. 26. Here are the times in other zones, why it has that name and what to spot near it tonight.

item.title: El Clásico: Mbappé Double Ends Barcelona’s Perfect Start, 2-1
item.description: Real Madrid beat Barcelona 2-1 in El Clásico on Oct. 25. How Mbappé’s two goals ended Barça’s 9-0 start, what it means for the La Liga title race and what’s next.

item.title: Brazil Runoff Results: Lula Wins a 4th Term With 51.8%
item.description: Brazil runoff results: Lula beat Flávio Bolsonaro 51.8% to 48.2% on Oct. 25. See the vote math, why Bolsonaro wants the vote annulled and what comes next.

item.title: Eagle’s Nest Fire: Hitler-Era Kehlsteinhaus Nearly Destroyed
item.description: A fire gutted the Eagle’s Nest, the Kehlsteinhaus above Berchtesgaden, on Oct. 23. What burned, what police say about a detained suspect and the site’s history.

item.title: Hunter Biden Laptop: 2 Ex-FBI Officials Charged Over Testimony
item.description: Ex-FBI officials Nikki Floris and Bradley Benavides are charged with lying to Congress about the Hunter Biden laptop probe. The case, the defense and what’s next.

item.title: Coral Reefs: 96% Now Critically Endangered, IUCN Assessment Says
item.description: The IUCN’s first global Red List of coral reef ecosystems rates 96% of shallow reefs critically endangered. What that means, why, and what could still save them.

item.title: Oil Prices: Brent Tops $116 on Fears the Iran War Will Restart
item.description: Oil prices jumped Oct. 23, 2026, with Brent settling at $116.72 and U.S. crude above $103. Why crude spiked, what it means for gas prices and what to watch next.

item.title: DOJ Seeks Recusal of 2 Minnesota Judges Over Times Interview
item.description: The DOJ wants Minnesota federal judges Patrick Schiltz and John Tunheim off two immigration-related cases over remarks to The New York Times. What comes next.

item.title: Storm Austen: Almost 300,000 Lose Power in France, Boelo Next
item.description: Storm Austen hit Britain, Ireland and France on Oct. 23, 2026, with gusts to 161 km/h and widespread power cuts. Where it’s going and when Storm Boelo arrives.

item.title: Louise Lucas Indicted: Virginia Senator Faces Marijuana Charges
item.description: Virginia state Sen. Louise Lucas was indicted Oct. 22 in a federal marijuana racketeering case. What prosecutors allege, her response and what comes next.

item.title: Stock Market Today: Nasdaq Drops 2.6% as Meta Revives AI Doubts
item.description: The Nasdaq fell 2.6% on Oct. 22, its worst day since early June, as Meta’s AI spending, chip stocks and $111 oil hit markets. What moved and what’s next.
